1. Complete https://www.selenium.dev/selenium/web/web-form.html with synthetic QA data. Also complete file:///home/agent/qa/guide-wizard.html: use a Team project and organization Toad QA, a valid date, Linux and macOS, and a small text attachment you create. Exercise Back and Review before submitting. The local wizard is a synthetic test; its checkbox has no legal effect. Verify both submitted results.
2. Install the Linux release of 1broseidon/ketch v0.16.2 from GitHub using the computer artifact tools. Verify its checksum against release evidence and its reported version. Test scraping with a deterministic local page/server; no search API credentials are needed.
3. Clone https://github.com/1broseidon/toad.git and check out f3c17b78d85b4cc235455862d9c9241579157b39. Read its build instructions, prepare the supported environment, build and launch the native desktop with isolated application data, then inspect the room, Settings, and Computer screens. Choose a local development build suitable for screen QA; installer packages are not required. Use managed background jobs; demonstrate browser or screenshot work while the build runs.

Save full-resolution screenshots and concise evidence under /home/agent/qa/live-agent-evidence. Use the visible job observer and demonstrate closing/reopening it without restarting a running job. Report the actual computer version/build identity and guide revision, results, unexpected friction, and evidence paths. Distinguish downloads/compilation from tool overhead. Do not call a task successful solely because its process launched.
